queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Omnissa Horizon Client' AND publisher = 'Omnissa, LLC';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Omnissa Horizon Client' AND publisher = 'Omnissa, LLC' AND version_compare(version, '8.19.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'omnissa horizon client.exe');
